description: Bidirectional sync — Performs a bidirectional synchronisation between two paths, supporting safety checks and recovery options.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_config.description: JSON encoded config overrides applied for this call only.

_filter.description: JSON encoded filter overrides applied for this call only.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

backupdir1.description: Backup directory on the first remote for changed files.

backupdir2.description: Backup directory on the second remote for changed files.

checkAccess.description: Set to true to abort if `RCLONE_TEST` files are missing on either side.

checkFilename.description: Override the access-check sentinel filename; defaults to `RCLONE_TEST`.

checkSync.description: Controls final listing comparison; leave true for normal verification or set false to skip.

createEmptySrcDirs.description: Set to true to mirror empty directories between the two paths.

dryRun.description: Set to true to simulate the bisync run without making changes.

filtersFile.description: Path to an rclone filters file applied to both paths.

force.description: Set to true to bypass the `maxDelete` safety check.

ignoreListingChecksum.description: Set to true to ignore checksum differences when comparing listings.

maxDelete.description: Abort the run if deletions exceed this percentage (default 50).

noCleanup.description: Set to true to keep bisync working files after completion.

removeEmptyDirs.description: Set to true to remove empty directories during cleanup.

resilient.description: Set to true to allow retrying after certain recoverable errors.

resync.description: Set to true to perform a one-time resync, rebuilding bisync history.

workdir.description: Directory path used to store bisync working files.

name: sync_bisync
